title: Proper/open projection equation in exact pullback coordinates
statement: Fix a finite commutative ring A. Let i:W to C and k:Z to Zbar be quasi-compact opens, v:W to Z and t:C to Zbar be proper, and h:i t=v k. For arbitrary Q in D(W_proet,A) and N in D(Z_proet,A), put J=k_!N and let Gamma be properOpenMate(i,v,t,k,h). Using the exact-pullback projection of [def-pur-product-open-tensor-projection-data], delta_(R_vQ,N) followed by k_!(projection_v(Q,N)) and Gamma_(Q tensor P_vN) equals (Gamma_Q tensor identity_J) followed by projection_t(i_!Q,J) and R_t(gamma_i(Q,P_tJ) followed by i_!(identity_Q tensor (square_(i,t,v,k) followed by P_v(openUnit_N inverse)))). This is the equation before any product tensor map d is pasted.

source.place: Symmetry paragraph, proper reduction; explicit proof Steps 1--5 of lem-pur-product-open-tensor-projection.

proof.text: Apply properOpenProjectionMate to the square (i,v,t,k) and objects Q,J. Transport all total left-derived pullbacks through leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory, using naturality with tensor and proper direct image. Canonical derived pullback composition transports to the exact square comparison since both localize the same upperStar composition. Identify P_kJ=N by the inverse open unit. Naturality of projection in its second input moves this map through projection_v; naturality of Gamma moves the induced tensor map through Gamma. The transported tensor and projection maps are exactly gamma and projection by definition. The resulting equality is the stated one, without inversion of a projection map.

lean.statement: theorem exactProperOpenProjectionMate (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {W C Z Zb : Scheme.{u}} (i : W ⟶ C) (v : W ⟶ Z) (t : C ⟶ Zb) (k : Z ⟶ Zb) [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion k] [QuasiCompact i] [QuasiCompact k] [IsProper v] [IsProper t] (h : i ≫ t = v ≫ k) (Q : FiniteD A W) (N : FiniteD A Z) : (gamma A k ((ProperOpenPush A v).obj Q) ((finiteShriek A k).obj N) ≫ (finiteShriek A k).map (tensorMap A Z (𝟙 _) (openUnit A k N).inv)) ≫ (finiteShriek A k).map (projection A v Q N) ≫ (properOpenMate A i v t k h).app (tensor A W Q ((pull A v).obj N)) = tensorMap A Zb ((properOpenMate A i v t k h).app Q) (𝟙 ((finiteShriek A k).obj N)) ≫ projection A t ((finiteShriek A i).obj Q) ((finiteShriek A k).obj N) ≫ (ProperOpenPush A t).map (gamma A i Q ((pull A t).obj ((finiteShriek A k).obj N)) ≫ (finiteShriek A i).map (tensorMap A W (𝟙 Q) (((square A i t v k h).app ((finiteShriek A k).obj N) ≪≫ (pull A v).mapIso (openUnit A k N).symm).hom)))
